regime_context: The detector ranks Oil & Gas Producers as the clear leader (score 1.61, eligible, breadth 0.79) with Gold Miners a distant challenger (1.11, breadth only 0.27). Leadership is broad but NOT one-narrative; crowding is present in Oil & Gas and Technology but the backtest verdict confirms this is a focus/style lens, not a forecast. Track record direction accuracy is weak (0.343) vs a flattering hit-rate, so directional conviction must be low.
emerging_watch: Watching for a CONFIRMED handoff from Oil & Gas to Gold Miners: the challenger (1.11) is not yet close (margin 0.502) and its durability has not exceeded the leader's. Would retire this watch if Gold Miners' durability_bar rises above Oil & Gas' 0.68 AND its breadth breaks above 0.5 — the current leader's durability is the observable to beat.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The only scorable theme that is both ranked #1 and shows real persistence: durability_bar 0.68, breadth 0.786, and the absolute-trend gate (validated risk control) keeps it eligible. This is a leadership-following lean, not a forecast — the trend-gate leg supports staying with it while it remains eligible, and crowding is a cap-not-fade caution only.
evidence: eligible under absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg)
crowding_z 1.04 → crowded: SIZE DOWN caution, not a sell
theses.dissent: Crowding (crowded=true) marks attention tops on sector ETFs historically; mixed hurst and a 0.343 direction-accuracy track record mean the leadership could fade without warning. Energy leadership is reflexive and can reverse violently on a macro shock.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its own 50-day trend gate (absolute-trend eligibility flips to false) before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Ranked #2 and eligible, but its leadership legs are thin: durability_bar only 0.48, breadth a narrow 0.267, hurst mixed. The trend-gate keeps it eligible, which supports not abandoning it entirely, but relative to the broad Oil & Gas leader it offers poor persistence texture. Lean is a relative preference against gold miners versus the leader, not a sell or short.
evidence: breadth 0.267 — leadership is narrow, not broad
rotation.breadth_of_rotation.frac 0.5 → broad rotation, so weak persistence matters
theses.dissent: Gold miners often lead on macro tail risk (unscheduled_share 1.0 in macro backdrop signals high surprise risk), and mean-revert metals can spike on safety bids. Underweighting gold while overweighting cyclical energy is a pro-risk tilt that would look wrong in a flight-to-safety.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO crosses above XEG.TO in trailing 15-day return while holding its own trend-gate eligibility

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
